consent.title: Before we start
consent.body: We'll use your device's camera to take a selfie and generate an AI image of you in a future career. Your photo stays in this session only and is never saved or stored.

name.title: What's your name?
name.subtitle: Your name will appear with your photo

capture.title: Take a Selfie
capture.subtitle: Take a clear photo of your face, or choose one from your gallery
capture.permissionError: We couldn't access the camera. You can choose a photo from your gallery instead.

career.title: Pick Your Future Career
career.subtitle: What will future you look like?

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't create the image this time. Please try again.
